population: Use the entire sealed F1+F2 18 starts, retaining the original 10 screens. For every motion-eligible A0/A1 case, inspect the first 3.0 s after tick 5703: the shared 1 s initial hold, whole 1.9 s registered excursion, and 0.1 s parked. Count all 30 installed targets per case with both native 25-tick atoms and every adjacent replacement in that interval.
measure: Align consecutive accepted raw EEF/base world targets by absolute simulation time on their common 50 ms knots. Compare positions (1 micrometre tolerance) and SO(3) angles (1e-5 rad); preserve zero changes, report first differing knot relative to the new installation. Reproduce the immutable actual wire hash, join each true installation to solver-echo IDs, and the two actually completed 50ms consumption windows. Report future lookahead supplied to the optimizer and separate actual state-policy horizon.
arm_evidence: Identify every post-start arm position+velocity request in the fixed 3s by comparison with all temporally compatible archived solver outputs, using the frozen 150ms joint-position and 10ms joint-velocity queries. Keep exact-content unique, ambiguous, absent, unjoined solver targets, and observer delivery order. Bind same-target echoes to source wire by original trajectory identity. Report old/current target matches following installation; never equate echo, selection and direct physical application.
decision: Old and new consumed packet identities with different future poses establish that installed future reference content was replaced in these known native tasks. Even if a target is replaceable, a queued policy may still depend on it. No shorter safe horizon for arbitrary SLA motion without dynamic and fault evidence. If sources allow, test a separately named CPU revision scheduler with a protected near prefix and explicit reversible predictions, comparing all 10 archived chronological pairs with the full-preview baseline. No physical grant implied.
